# Release notes template

Copy this into a draft GitHub release after choosing the actual version and tag. Replace each instruction with verified release-specific information before publishing.

## Changes

Describe user-visible additions, fixes and any removals. Reference the matching CHANGELOG.md entry and actual issues/PRs.

## Compatibility and upgrade

State the application/Agent versions, SQLite schema, supported upgrade origins, backup procedure and rollback requirements. Identify API or permission changes.

## Downloads

List only artifacts actually attached, with OS/architecture, archive contents and the SHA-256 manifest filename. State whether binaries are signed. Do not advertise a container image or platform that was not built and tested.

## Verification

Record commit, build toolchain, automated checks, target-machine smoke tests and known untested areas. Separate cross-compilation from runtime verification.

## Known limitations

List release-specific limitations, operational prerequisites and links to the current guides.
